the learning materials can enable learners to experience flow states, and that the learners’ learning behavioral patterns can be inferred from the flow state.
the game-based learning environment can enable students to experience a flow state and to achieve a high level of knowledge acquisition.
the game-based learning materials can enable learners to acquire knowledge via repeated “learning with game” behavioral patterns, and can enable learners to have flow experiences.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of an anti-phishing game and the analysis of learning behavioral patterns.
the design of learning activities, the development of learning materials, the design of learning environments, and the exploration of learners’ behavioural patterns.
the relationship between learners’ behavioral patterns, flow states, and learning performance in the context of game-based learning.

the learning materials and the game used in this study are effective in enabling learners’ flow experiences, which in turn enables learners’ repeated “learning with game playing” behavioral pattern, and improves their learning achievement.
the learning materials and the game-based anti-phish educational program can effectively enable learners to experience flow and improve their learning performance.
this study can provide an effective learning model for the design of anti-phishing educational games.

we have developed an anti-phishing educational game that can enable learners to acquire knowledge through trial and errors via a repeated learning with gaming behavioral pattern.
the flow state is an important indicator of learning behavioral patterns, which is related to learning performance in game-based learning.
the learning with gaming behavioral pattern is the best learning behavioral pattern for the learners to achieve a flow state and acquire knowledge.

game-based learning can be a good way to teach anti-phishing skills to elementary school students.
